android.desc:
Learn Spanish, French, Sanskrit, Hindi, German, Japanese, and more with an AI language tutor. Indilingo brings guided lessons, chat practice, speaking exercises and vocabulary games together in one app.

Start with a language you already understand. Choose from 39 supported languages as the language you know or the language you want to learn. Learn Spanish through Hindi, German through Bengali or Hindi through English. You don't have to learn through English first.

Practice for real conversations
Chat with an AI tutor, ask questions and try useful phrases for travel, work and everyday life. Get explanations in your chosen language and practice at your level.

Speak and get feedback
Practice speaking with an AI tutor and review pronunciation feedback where supported. Rehearse introductions, ordering food, asking directions and other everyday situations.

Follow lessons built around your goals
Start a personalized learning path based on your level, interests and purpose. Work on vocabulary, grammar and sentence patterns with guided conversations and quizzes.

Understand the words you meet
Look up meanings, pronunciation, examples and related words in the dictionary. See how vocabulary fits into a sentence instead of learning isolated translations.

Make time for daily practice
Play language games such as Word Maze and Bhasha Battle. Build your vocabulary, earn XP, keep a streak and track your progress.

39 supported languages
Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Chinese, English, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Dutch, Polish, Indonesian, Thai, Turkish and Vietnamese.

Also learn all 22 Scheduled Languages of India: Assamese, Bengali, Bodo, Dogri, Gujarati, Hindi, Kannada, Kashmiri, Konkani, Maithili, Malayalam, Manipuri, Marathi, Nepali, Odia, Punjabi, Sanskrit, Santali, Sindhi, Tamil, Telugu and Urdu.

Each supported language can be the language you learn or the language you learn from. Choose what fits your next trip, a new community, family conversations or a personal learning goal.

Free and Pro access
Download Indilingo to try the core learning experience. AI chat and speaking have free-use limits. Additional access requires an Indilingo Pro subscription. Feature availability can vary by language.

Choose the language you speak, pick the language you want to learn and start a conversation.

Website: www.indilingo.in
Support: contact@indilingo.in

quotes.text:
Hi HN, Jay here. I am building Indilingo, an AI app for learning Indian languages like Hindi, Sanskrit, Tamil, Kannada and more.

It supports 14 official Indian languages at the moment and is available on the Play Store with 800+ downloads.

We're a small group of friends building this bootstrapped from Bengaluru, India and would love to get your feedback on it!

Features:

1. Real-time AI powered personalization for all lessons.

2. Custom lessons - Users can create their own lessons based on their goals.

3. Conversation practice (launching this week!) - Users can practice speaking in real-time with an AI and get instant feedback on their pronunciation.

4. Truly accessible - Users can learn any supported language from any supported language. Today, we have 180+ language combinations possible. Tomorrow it will be a thousand.

Here is the link to our website: https://www.indilingo.in

And here is the download link on Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.indilingo
